screening_attempts.quarantine_resolution_reason: Policy-v13 copy REJECT: unmodified fork of a released agent, disguised by identifier renames. future v1 (SHA 6b70ee67...5b82) is a fork of DrPresident v22 eeb26552 (SHA 098f3e82...9098), a different owner's agent that was public before this upload (first exact-SHA public handoff 2026-11-01T23:30Z; upload 2026-11-02T11:12Z). Reusing released source is allowed, but a fork must make its own runtime change to be separately eligible (october-29-unmodified-fork-not-eligible; operator ruling 2026-11-01 that a one-line edit on a released base is too thin, as applied to beast v1/v3/v4). Diff against v22: 14 runtime files are byte-identical. The other 20 modified runtime files (app/agent.py, records.py, short.py, lane.py, thint.py, qtype.py, packet.py, llm.py, store.py, action.py, calc.py, config.py, answer.py, tools.py, surface.py, typography.py, protocol.py and memory/coverage.py, embedding.py, worksheet.py) only rename functions and variables (e.g. build_packet->make_packet, question_kind->form_kind, parse_slot->split_answer, plain_type->fold_type, normalize_user_id->user_key, link_hop->hop_links, with the HARNESS_LINK_HOP env var unchanged). Two behaviour-neutral refactors: one_edit moved from qtype.py/thint.py/lane.py into the new app/spell.py:5-14, and the v22 lane-placement elif chain moved into CaseRunner.opening_lane/place_lane (app/agent.py) with the same conditions in the same order. The only behavioural change is one argument in TopicPath.latest_draft (app/short.py:611-613, next_step=kind == "next"). DECLARATION.md is DrPresident v22's declaration with the same renames applied, including v22's own v20/v21 change tables. Renames and moved code are not an own runtime change, the same as whitespace. No I1-I8 or S1-S3 source violation is alleged; the screener's I5 leads on qtype.py are v22's routed guidance (october-23-routed-guidance). Unreleased-copy check (uc3): 17 non-base items, top match 0.25 (one shared identifier), so no unreleased code from another owner. This rejects this exact UUID only. It is not a ban, and a future fork of a released agent with its own substantive runtime work remains eligible.
